name: manage-suite
description: Manage Suite by Crisp Future — an operating partner, inside Claude, for your deals, team, boss, and stakeholders, that remembers you across conversations. Adds a /coach skill (executive coaching) plus the "Manage My…" operator lenses (/manageme, /manageteam, /manageboss, /managestakeholders) and connects the Manage Suite server (Engine mode — every response runs on the Manage Suite backend and is relayed into the conversation).
